notes.title: Platinum Coins Update Patch
notes.notes:
The issue experienced by users when purchasing Platinum Coins in STEAM version of Dragon Ball Z: KAKAROT have been fixed with an update patch.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

Other responses are currently under consideration, please wait for future updates.

notes.title: Patch Note Announcement
notes.notes:
We are aware that users on the Steam version of DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT are experiencing network errors and log in issues when trying to access DRAGON BALL CARD WARRIORS after purchasing Platinum Coins.
We are currently working on a update patch which will fix this issue and allow users who have already encountered this issue to log in properly. 

Until then, please do not purchase Platinum Coins on the Steam version of CARD WARRIORS.
Users who have encountered the issue will receive the correct amount of Platinum Coins for their purchases after the issue is fixed.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
A new patch has been released in Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot. Please find below the Patch Note:

- Fixed an issue where an application error sometimes occur when playing the ‘Training’ inside Capsule Corp., using a character different from the character you have been controlling on the field.

- Fixed an issue where users are stuck in ‘Android Saga - Episode 10’, by following the steps.
[olist]
 Watch the scene at the God's temple.
 Wait for the auto save to finish.
 Close the application.
 Load the auto save data.
[/olist]
- Made other adjustments.

 
The Time Machine will be activated later this month!

notes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello Z Warriors! A new patch has been released for Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot. 
Update 1.04 implements the following fixes:

LOADING TIME
 Reduced Loading Times when travelling from one area to another

OTHER FIXES
 Fixed issue where players were unable to accept the Sub Story “Telekinesis Training” (Saiyan Arc Episode 3), if you saved and loaded your Save Data after fighting Tien
 Fixed issue that caused the Main Story icon to not be displayed if you saved and loaded your Save Data after clearing the Main Story “The Longest Three Hours” (Saiyan Arc Episode 5)
 Fixed issue where Chi-Chi couldn’t be found on the field if you accepted the Sub Story “Goten’s Growth” (Buu Arc Episode 1) and cleared the Main Story without completing the Sub Story
 Fixed issue that caused characters related to the Main or Sub Story to not appear if that specific character is already found within the field as a Villainous Enemy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35812483/8b91b10525267942e5db6d0cc16a973fdecb76cd.jpg 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35812483/8d475b7690a39bf4e43d970a4a5b314f43eac0a0.jpg 

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates!
